br-empire.title: Flag of the Empire of Brazil
desc:
- The Empire of Brazil (1822–1889) used a green field with a golden yellow rhombus and the imperial coat of arms — the green-and-gold design carried into the republic
- **Construction:** a green field with a gold diamond centred (similar to the modern flag)
- Inside the diamond, the Imperial arms with the coffee and tobacco branches and the imperial crown
trivia:
- The Brazilian Empire flag (1822–1889) featured the imperial coat of arms
- The yellow diamond represented the House of Braganza (the imperial dynasty)
- The empire lasted 67 years before the republican revolution

br-provisional.title: Flag of the Provisional Republic of Brazil
desc:
- The Provisional Flag of the Republic of Brazil (15–19 November 1889) was used for four days after the overthrow of the Empire
- It was inspired by the United States flag, with 13 green and yellow horizontal stripes and a blue canton with white stars
- Quickly replaced by the iconic green-and-yellow diamond design, this flag was never popular and was seen as too imitative
- **Construction:** 13 alternating green and yellow horizontal stripes with a dark blue canton containing 21 white stars. Ratio approximately 7:10

countryData.name: Brazil
countryData.officialName: Republic of the United States of Brazil

trivia:
- Brazil's provisional flag was used during the transition from empire to republic
- Represents the period of political transformation in the 1890s
- Shows the evolution of Brazilian national symbols
